name: nanohttpd
input_api: NanoHTTPD.HTTPSession(TempFileManager, local InputStream, OutputStream).execute(); override serve(IHTTPSession) to inspect parsed method, URI, query and headers
scope: HTTP/1.1 request method, target, Host and X-Parsarium headers from local stream; protocol version is internal and not reported
family_note: A protected HTTPSession is instantiated inside a NanoHTTPD subclass using local byte streams; execute() invokes serve() with parsed request fields. The control includes Connection: close, so the normal session shutdown SocketException is caught after a parsed callback. No listening socket is opened.

name: sentinel-transport-simple-http
input_api: new SimpleHttpResponseParser().parse(local InputStream); getStatusLine(), getStatusCode(), getHeader(name), getBodyAsString()
scope: HTTP/1.1 response status line, status code, Content-Type header, and nine-byte body from local stream
family: Sentinel native simple HTTP response parser
family_note: Sentinel transport parses raw HTTP responses with Content-Length. Its documented parser does not support chunked responses; only the valid fixed-length control is verified. The adapter suppresses package startup log chatter while reporting parsed fields.

name: mina-http
input_api: new HttpServerDecoder().decode(DummySession, IoBuffer.wrap(localBytes), ProtocolDecoderOutput); collect HttpRequest and read getMethod(), getRequestPath(), getQueryString(), getProtocolVersion(), getHeader(lowercaseName)
scope: HTTP/1.1 request line and headers from local bytes
family: Apache MINA native HTTP server decoder
family_note: The 2.2.10 mina-http source writes a native HttpRequestImpl into ProtocolDecoderOutput; headers are normalized to lowercase. The Maven POM declares mina-core with bundle type, which Maven cannot resolve as a normal artifact; adapter POM excludes that broken transitive edge and explicitly pins the same mina-core JAR. slf4j-nop pins the 1.7 logger binding for deterministic quiet output.

name: grizzly-http
input_api: HttpServerFilter.handleRead(FilterChainContext containing Buffers.wrap(MemoryManager, localBytes)); context.getMessage() as HttpContent; getHttpHeader() as HttpRequestPacket
scope: HTTP/1.1 request line and headers from local bytes
family_note: The pinned Grizzly HttpServerFilter decodes an in-memory Buffer into HttpContent carrying its native HttpRequestPacket. The adapter constructs an unconnected TCPNIOConnection solely as a filter context; no listener or network request is involved. The handler returns method, target, protocol and headers.

name: ssl-proxies
input_api: new org.globus.util.http.HTTPResponseParser(local InputStream); getStatusCode(), getMessage(), getContentType(), getContentLength()
scope: HTTP/1.1 response status and headers from local stream
family_note: The ssl-proxies artifact includes its own HTTPParser and HTTPResponseParser classes. The response parser reads the local InputStream directly and reports status, reason and headers; the valid control verifies those fields, not response body handling. Apache-2.0 header is in the pinned source JAR.

name: java-warc
input_api: new ResponseContentBlockFactory(new HeaderParser()).newResponseContentBlock(local InputStream); getStatusCode(), getMimeType(), getPayloadAsString()
scope: HTTP/1.1 response status, Content-Type and body from local stream
family: java-warc response wrapper over Apache HttpComponents Core 4.x parser
family_note: Public ResponseContentBlockFactory accepts a raw local HTTP response InputStream without a WARC container and returns a structured response block. Its POM depends on httpcore 4.4.14; the combined adapter classpath resolves httpcore 4.4.16. Counted as a separate Maven package path, not an independent parser engine.
